title: How Ava’s brain is shown
question: Three ways to see and edit Ava without talking to her. The world stays the admin you already have. Lock the composition.

options.label: The spine
options.thesis: Ava’s brain as a left-to-right spine: who she is, how she routes, the skill she opens, the knowledge it pulls.
options.viewport: Sticky header Ava with Structure, Skills, Knowledge. A horizontal spine of four nodes. Click a node and the markdown opens on the right.
options.risk: A pipeline can look like a tutorial diagram and hide the file you came to edit.

raised.raise: Changing tone remakes the identity plaque live, the same way a weight slider remakes every glyph.
The spine reads as one turn: always-loaded layers sit under the working skill, not beside it as equals.
The selected node’s name is the largest type on the page.

options.label: The stack
options.thesis: The protocol itself is the page — five stacked layers, click any one to read and edit it.
options.viewport: Full-width stack: Identity, Router, Skills, References, This coach. Selecting Skills expands the capability list in place.
options.risk: A stack is honest and can feel like a spec sheet.

options.label: The atlas
options.thesis: First you see everything she can do, grouped the way a job actually runs.
options.viewport: Identity plaque at the top. Four clusters: Blueprint, Prospects, Campaigns, Guide. Click Fill the gaps and the inspector opens CONTEXT.md plus blueprint-quality.
options.risk: A map of skills can bury identity, tone, and shared knowledge.

regions.label: Ava · Hi, I'm Ava · tone rules

options.label: The interchange
options.thesis: Jobs are lines. Skills are stations. You trace a request the way she routes it.
options.viewport: Identity as the central interchange. Four coloured lines — Blueprint, Prospects, Campaigns, Guide — with stations named for skills. Click a station and the file opens beside the map.
options.case: Beats the spine on both axes: Blueprint versus Campaigns are different lines, and the interchange is identity.
options.risk: A pretty network that you cannot edit is a poster.

options.label: The manual
options.thesis: Skills, knowledge, and identity as a tabbed manual — the current tab is the whole board.
options.viewport: Fore-edge tabs Identity, Skills, Knowledge, Flow. Skills is a list of CONTEXT files as stacked leaves; open one to edit.
options.case: Holds identification because you asked for tabs, and hides the graph until you click.
options.risk: Becomes Brand’s Core brain with a new title.

options.label: The board
options.thesis: The always-on pass sits still; the board reranks what she would open for this job.
options.viewport: Left: a segmented always-loaded pass for AGENT.md and ROUTER.md. Right: a ranked board of skills. Picking Fill the gaps lights its references and holds them.
options.case: Holds the always-versus-opened split; the airport metaphor is extra.
options.risk: Cute metaphor, unclear that you can edit the files.

options.label: Live tone
options.thesis: Tone sliders remake the identity preview the way a weight axis remakes every glyph.
options.viewport: A giant Ava mark. Drag Directness and the identity text thickens.
options.case: Shows tone, hides the graph of skills and knowledge.
options.kept: A change remakes the preview live.
options.risk: A specimen is not a map of her brain.

options.label: The score
options.thesis: A turn reads upward: always-loaded layers below, the opened skill above.
options.viewport: A vertical staff. Identity and router as the beat. A skill block whose height is how much context it loads.
options.case: Beautiful, and an admin cannot find AGENT.md.
options.kept: A turn reads as stacked time.
options.risk: Notation that needs a key fails Operate.

options.label: Giant tiles
options.thesis: Each layer is a colour field; the selected name is the interface.
options.viewport: Four huge tiles: Identity, Skills, Knowledge, Flow. The open tile floods sky.
options.case: Fights the admin world and deletes the file.
options.kept: The selected name is the largest type.
options.risk: A tile panorama is a Start screen, not a brain.
